description: This file implements a Dart client for interacting with the NewsAPI. It provides functionality to fetch news articles based on categories and countries, handles API errors, manages HTTP requests, and parses JSON responses into NewsArticle objects.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to NewsAPI interactions.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: A client class to fetch news articles from the NewsAPI, managing request construction, error handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: NewsApiClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HTTP client.

methods.name: _maskApiKeyInUrl
methods.description: Obfuscates the apiKey parameter in URLs for logging purposes.

methods.name: _extractNewsApiErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a helpful error message from a JSON-decoded response from the NewsAPI.

methods.name: _debugLog
methods.description: Logs debug messages only in debug mode.

methods.name: _queryForCategory
methods.description: Maps the provided category to a broad search query string suitable for NewsAPI.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Fetches top news articles based on country and category, handling API responses and errors.

methods.name: _languageForCountry
methods.description: Returns a language code based on the country code for use in the API query.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the internal HTTP client to clean up resources.
